Brotli static dictionary — RFC 7932 Appendix A
==============================================

Used in: src/io/compress/brotli_dict.bin (and its copy under dist/build/),
the 122 784-byte static dictionary of the Brotli format, loaded by
src/io/compress/brotli_dict_words.js. The file is bit-identical to the
"Static Dictionary Data" of RFC 7932 Appendix A (CRC-32 0x5136CB04, as the
appendix states; SHA-256
20e42eb1b511c21806d4d227d07e5dd06877d8ce7b3a817f378f313653f35c70). It was
copied from the reference implementation's repository, google/brotli
(c/common/dictionary.bin). Both notices follow.
